name: France: micro-entrepreneurs (auto-entrepreneurs)
dueNote: Micro-entrepreneurs declaring quarterly pay URSSAF contributions (and the optional versement libératoire) by the end of the month after each quarter.

presets.label: Liberal profession (BNC, non-regulated), VAT franchise: URSSAF 25.8%
BNC with versement libératoire: URSSAF 25.8% + income tax 2.2%
BNC above the VAT franchise: VAT 20% + URSSAF 25.8%

notes: 2026 URSSAF rates on turnover: 25.6% + 0.2% CFP for non-regulated liberal professions (BNC), 21.2% + up to 0.3% CFP for BIC services. The versement libératoire is optional and depends on household income.
Under the VAT franchise no VAT is charged; above it the standard rate is 20% (reduced 10%, 5.5%, 2.1%).
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
